name: silo-raycast
title: Silo
description: Save links to silo and search your library, without leaving Raycast.
author: amit_ray

commands.name: save-to-silo
commands.title: Save to Silo
commands.description: Instantly save the frontmost browser tab (or clipboard URL) to silo.

commands.name: save-with-details
commands.title: Save to Silo with Details

commands.name: search-silo
commands.title: Search Silo
commands.description: Search your silo library and open a result.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: The silo API this extension talks to.

preferences.title: API Token
